install.note: Install from GitHub; the import name is always @gaudi/design-system.

global.use: Apps without their own Tailwind entry: loads Tailwind v4, Gaudi tokens, foundations and component CSS, and scans the package source.

styles.use: Apps that own their Tailwind entry: import after `@import "tailwindcss";` and add `@source` for the package.

tailwind.usage: Tailwind v4 loads Gaudi's config through global.css. For a JS config, use `presets: [require('@gaudi/design-system/tailwind-preset')]` (colours, radii, typography and the prose theme).

nextjs.note: Gaudi ships React source (JSX); a JSX-aware bundler is required.

themes.apply: Set data-theme="<id>" on <html> and import '@gaudi/design-system/themes.css', or wrap the app in ThemeProvider from '@gaudi/design-system/themes' (injects and persists the active theme) and render getThemeScript() in <head> to avoid a flash.
themes.runtime: import { ThemeProvider, useTheme, getThemeScript, applyTheme, listThemes } from '@gaudi/design-system/themes';
themes.contract: src/tokens/THEMING.md (themeable --ds-* tokens per mode, fonts, radius, shadows); schema themes/theme.schema.json.
themes.cli: gaudi-ds theme list | import <file|url> | export <id> --format css|shadcn|registry|json | check <id> | generate --brand <colour>
themes.storybook: The Theming guide (theming-overview--default) renders THEMING.md with live swatches, presets and contrast; the Theme Studio guide edits, generates and exports; the Theme preset toolbar previews any story in any preset.

imports.rule: Prefer owner leaf entries (e.g. @gaudi/design-system/core/Button) in route code; root and category entries are valid. Only package.json exports are public; never import src/ paths.
